So is your muscle.

The shoulders that filled out a polo? Smaller. The arms that filled a sleeve? Softer. The chest your wife used to grab? Flatter. The jawline that came back when you lost weight in your 30s? Not coming back this time.

You wanted to lose fat. You're losing the wrong thing.

Your prescribing doctor mentioned the nausea. The injection schedule. The diet rules.

Rapid weight loss doesn't politely ask your body which tissue to burn. It takes whatever's easiest. And at 45, 50, 55, that's the muscle you spent a decade in the gym building.

Lighter on the scale. Skinnier in the mirror. Weaker in the gym.

That's not the trade you signed up for.

👉 Read the 10 things GLP-1s are quietly doing to men's bodies — and what's keeping muscle while the fat actually comes off.

verification.headline: Losing Weight on a GLP-1? You're Losing the Wrong Thing.
verification.description: 10 things happening inside your body that the scale doesn't show.
verification.primary_text:
You're losing fat.

You're also losing muscle.

And it's way more than your doctor told you. A real chunk of every pound coming off a GLP-1 isn't fat. It's lean tissue. Muscle.

That's the trade-off nobody mentioned at the prescription appointment.

Six months in, the man in the mirror is smaller — but softer. Lighter — but flatter. Skinnier sleeves. Weaker handshake. Less of you for your wife to actually grab onto.

You wanted to look BETTER. The scale says you should be winning.

Your reflection says otherwise.

And here's the part nobody talks about: once you come off the med, the fat returns faster than the muscle ever does. After 45, that muscle isn't easy to get back. Some men never rebuild what they lose.

You're not just losing it for the year you're on the drug. You're losing it for keeps if you don't fight for it.

👉 See the 10 things every man on Ozempic, Wegovy, or Mounjaro needs to know about body composition — and the moves that actually preserve muscle while the fat comes off.

That's not a coincidence. That's the side effect that doesn't make the warning label.
